title: At a tangent point the density equals the multiplicity
statement: If an n-varifold V on open U ⊆ ℝ^N has tangent plane T with multiplicity θ at x (HasTangentPlane V x T θ, Def. 8.1.1), then Θ^n(μ_V, x) exists and equals ofReal θ (HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ)
